name: Geometric Intersection Obfuscation
description: The problem is recast from selecting variables subject to a combinatorial pair constraint into finding a binary vector satisfying a non-linear projection equation in Euclidean space. The pair constraints are transformed into sparse constraint vectors, and the global condition is expressed using dot products and exponentiation. The right-hand side aggregates all constraints into a single sum vector `w`. To recognize this as Independent Set, a model must explicitly expand the dot product `x · w`, equate terms, and deduce that the equation only holds when no constraint vector has a dot product of 2. This breaks the direct mapping to graph edges and prevents the model from triggering its optimized graph-search heuristics.
